summary: Frontend-only retest of checkout redirect fix and quick regressions. All 4 requested flows PASSED. Guest checkout now navigates to /order-success/{order_number} correctly (JH202600007), cart is cleared only after success (badge=0), Track Order prefills order id and shows 'Placed' + 'Payment Confirmed' + 'Paid' status. Coupon WELCOME10 correctly applies -₹150 when subtotal meets min_order ₹499.

issues: When coupon is applied but min_order not met (e.g., cart=₹229 vs WELCOME10 min ₹499), UI silently ignores the coupon with no user-visible error/toast. Consider surfacing 'Minimum order ₹499 required' message.

action_items: Optional: show a validation/toast when coupon fails min_order requirement (currently silent).
critical_code_review_comments: CheckoutPage fix verified: nav('/order-success/...') is fired before clearCart() and empty-cart useEffect is guarded by `submitted` flag — race condition resolved.
Two 401 console errors observed on public pages (likely /api/auth/me probe for guest) — non-blocking but should be swallowed to keep console clean.
test_credentials: Guest flow used (no login). Payments in MOCK mode.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 test order JH202600007 via guest checkout (mock payment). One additional cart session for coupon regression (not checked out).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Guest checkout → order-success → track flow is stable. WELCOME10 needs subtotal >= ₹499 (max_discount ₹150). Two harmless 401s on public routes from likely /api/auth/me probe.
rca of the issue: Previously items.length===0 useEffect on CheckoutPage redirected to /cart when clearCart() ran before navigation. Fix: set `submitted=true` inside placeOrder before nav, guard the empty-cart redirect with `if (submitted) return;`, and call nav('/order-success/'+order.order_number) BEFORE clearCart() in both mock and Razorpay branches. Verified working end-to-end.
